name: nsb
description: Noida Super Bazaar - Phase-1 Wedding MVP

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nsb/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nsb/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @nsb/api" "npm run dev -w @nsb/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nsb/shared && npm run build -w @nsb/api && npm run build -w @nsb/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nsb/shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
